maildir.description: Override $MAILDIR; path to Maildir directory containing .password (e.g., /home/user/Maildir)

user.description: Override $USER; system username whose home directory will be used for .password lookup

shell.description: Override $SHELL; shell to assign before invoking prog (e.g., /bin/sh)

groups.description: List of supplementary group names or IDs to assume before running prog

gid.description: Override GID; primary group ID to assume

uid.description: Override UID; user ID to assume

working_dir.description: Working directory to set before invoking prog

prog.description: Program and arguments (single string) to execute upon successful password check
